name: InkRoom
tagline: Guide InkRoom image workflows, authorized batches and complete original delivery
description: Companion Skill for the connected InkRoom MCP: preserve prompts, models and reference images; preview costs; follow spending authorization; resume original batches and verify complete original-image delivery. Requires an independently configured InkRoom MCP connection and the user's own account/Token. No local binary or Go build required.

install.notes: Install only this nested MCP-native Skill. Connect InkRoom MCP separately using your own Token. Do not import the repository-root standalone Go-client Skill or execute generation during installation.
